The '''smooka''' was a spade-headed rodent native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It had a prehensile tail and ulnar skin flaps that stiffened when leaping, allowing it to glide. A smooka's diet included berries, nuts, [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]] and [[Jubba bird/Legends|jubba bird]] nestlings, and their eggs. Smookas would also eat [[Leaf-tail/Legends|leaf-tail]] pups. The creature would chisel holes in trees with its teeth for nesting purposes, having up to five young per litter. Their teeth were extremely durable and could cut through metal armor and cage bars.<ref name="NoP" />

Predators include [[Dagobah python/Legends|Dagobah pythons]].
